project.name: MCP Search :: Adapter :: MySQL
project.description:
SearchAdapter implementation for MySQL 9.0+: full-text search via MATCH ... AGAINST over a FULLTEXT index, vector search via the native VECTOR type and DISTANCE() function, fused in-app through search-core's FusionStrategy.
REQUIRES MySQL 9.0 or newer for the vector channel - the VECTOR type and STRING_TO_VECTOR()/DISTANCE() functions do not exist in MySQL 8.x. Text-only search works on 8.x, but this adapter targets 9.x since the whole point is native hybrid.
Compile-time dependency is java.sql/javax.sql only - no driver jar required to build; the consuming application supplies a configured DataSource and the MySQL JDBC driver at runtime.
